summary.tldr: Requires the finance minister to develop a national framework for a guaranteed livable basic income for people over 17 and report to Parliament on it.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Finance to develop a Canada-wide framework for a guaranteed livable basic income program for people over 17, including temporary workers, permanent residents and refugee claimants.
Requires the minister to consult federal and provincial ministers, Indigenous elders, Indigenous governing bodies and other relevant stakeholders while developing the framework.
Requires the framework to define what counts as a livable basic income in each region and to set national standards for health and social supports that go with the program.
Requires the framework to say that people do not have to join education, training or the labour market to qualify.
Requires the framework to protect health or disability services and benefits from being reduced because of the program.
Requires the minister to table a report within one year, publish it online, and then review and report on the framework every year after that.
summary.background: The bill sets out a process for the Minister of Finance to develop and review a national framework for a guaranteed livable basic income.
